impact: Dell giving back its gains shows investors selling AI hardware strength rather than buying it, a bad sign for MU, DRAM, SNXX and NBIS today; a hot PCE print would cement the December hike and add pressure on yields and growth names.
summary: US stock futures fell on Wednesday morning as AI-trade worries lingered and traders priced roughly a 96% chance of a quarter-point Fed hike in December, per CME FedWatch as cited by reports. Dell, which rose after hours on its record quarter, was down about 7.5% premarket, and Workday fell 9.89% despite beating estimates; Autodesk was down about 4% and HP about 0.8%. Trump said a pardon for Jensen Huang is always an option but urged him to tell the truth to Congress. October PCE data is due at 8:30 a.m. ET.
title: Futures slip before PCE; Dell reverses to -7.5% premarket, Workday -9.9%
